brief: Replace the repeated 13-roof descent with at least ten times the length, varied dimensions and challenges, strong route curves and forks, level and ascending transfers, and no descending gaps.

scope: Only the Rooftop Relay source block and corresponding published pack entry change.
No movement tuning or shared runtime changes.
All other published entries compare equal as parsed data.
iterations: Lengthen four short slalom roofs to 64–66 m to fit existing skateboard steering at 23 m/s.
Use the existing foot double jump for longer, ramp and rising gaps; avoid incidental diagonal air input in the pilot. No movement tuning changes.
Broaden fork choice courts and ease the outward/rejoining curve. Remove real parapets and props from the complete branch clearance corridor.
Make parapets physical and preserve the real open atriums and native collapsing construction panels.

Validate grounded contact through actual source mesh IDs, including every alternate roof. Correct the main-route assertion to accept an incidental overlapping fork contact while still requiring all 132 main roofs.

mainFootAssertionReview.explanation: The complete run finished with all 132 main roofs. The initial exact-total assertion counted one additional physical contact at an overlapping fork merge; validation now requires every intended main roof without rejecting legitimate extra contacts. The unchanged-tuning assertion in the native run passed before that count assertion.

earlierFullRenderMain.stage: Before the final fork clearance removals; current-source foot and all-fork browser results are separately included.

checks.productionBuild: passed again after type-only compatibility adjustment, 49.48-second bundle after TypeScript check

limitations: Input pilots verify traversability and explicit error margins; they do not substitute for subjective human playtesting.
Native full main is tested on foot; continuous full-render all-fork run is tested skating. The two hardest alternate chains also have on-foot probes.
